reviews.title: The absolute worst
reviews.text:
How can Microsoft make such a simple app this terrible? Constant crashes, painfully slow, lost data, and an app that breaks whenever iOS updates. It’s a basic to-do list, yet I can’t even trust it to save my tasks. The app’s entire purpose is to keep people organized, and it can’t even do that reliably.

And the overwhelming number of five-star reviews? Hard to believe they’re all genuine. Bots? Microsoft employees? Because anyone who actually uses this app regularly knows how frustratingly bad it is.

The absolute worst app on my phone. Microsoft, fix your broken product. The bare minimum is making a to-do list that actually works.

reviews.title: Urgent: Sync no longer works reliable. Please fix ASAP!
reviews.text: Since about 10 days the sync of To Do between my devices (MacBook, iPhone, iPad) and between me and people with whom I share lists, does no longer reliably work. The sync happens either with a very long delay or not at all, or only in parts. The issue is fully reproducible and testable. I tested it several times between my devices and with people I share lists with. Other than software updates we did not change any settings. This is a major (!) problem and has already created issues as work when tasks were either not completed, because they did not show on other devices after sync or tasks were done in duplication, because the completion of the tasks were not checked off after sync. This is a major impact on workflows. Microsoft MUSST fix the issue asap. Too many workflows depend on it and it is not easy to establish an alternative quickly.

This isn’t my bank information, it’s a TO DO list !!!!!  If I can get signed in somehow (this is the 4th day trying) I’ll copy/paste my list to a much more manageable app!

reviews.title: Tiny to do list
reviews.text: The app is fine but I want a lager widget on my iPad screen so I can see my to do list but it only offers a tiny one on an empty page.  Very frustrating.

reviews.title: Not thought through
reviews.text: Aside from being slightly glitchy, there are just aspects that make no sense. Even if you turn off unused smart lists in settings, you cannot get rid of flagged tasks from outlook as a category. What about people who don’t flag tasks in outlook?! It’s clear that this is given no attention or thought, which is a real shame given how much effort Wunderlist put into this app before it was bought up.

reviews.title: Crashes every time there is a new list
reviews.text: Crashes every time there is a new list created. Cannot simply report the bug… hence review.

reviews.title: Parfait sur Windows, exécrable sur macOS, iOS et iPasOS
reviews.text: Inutilisable sur tout l’environnement Apple. C’est dommage parce que c’est mon appli préférée sur mon PC depuis des années. Il est temps pour moi de chercher une solution réellement multiplateformes.

reviews.title: Da migliorare molto
reviews.text: Non consente di spostare manualmente l’ordine di un item se ho scelto un opzione di ordinamento. Non ha funzionalità utili quali le categorie ed i relativi filtri (ad es. cliente, pratica, delegato, ecc.) e non sono presenti neppure come campi. Non consente di impostare diversi livelli di priorità. Manca un menu da cui scegliere i tag una volta creato l’item. Non è possibile modificare i tag. Non ci sono le sezioni all’interno di un elenco. Era molto meglio la funzione attività di outlook che c’era nei primi anni 2000. Forza sapete fare di meglio

reviews.title: Why the massive spaced out list?
reviews.text: I need something more akin to the old Task list.  Sorted by date and priority and listed in a compact tight list.   This over simplified dual line per item is not suitable for large task lists.

reviews.title: Terrible terrible terrible
reviews.text: I miss wundalist which I was using until Microsoft bought and destroyed it. Bring it back guys you’ve messed up. This app is awful to use and the slowest app I have. I just can’t find an alternative but I’d love one. Terrible.

reviews.title: Slow, crashes, won’t open
reviews.text: I’ve given it 2 stars because I’ve used it for years very successfully. It has been very slow and crashes and refuses to open most of the time. I see lots of forums talking about the same problem. None of the offered solutions seem to work.  I’ve deleted it and tried others but none work for me so I keep persevering. A great shame as it’s a good app. Please FIX it developer!
